name: Danubian Suebi
alt: Suebian kingdom of Hunimund and Alaric

predecessors.name: Huns
predecessors.text: 'somewhere near the old settlement area of the Marcomanni and the Quadi' (Hunimund page) and 'in or near north-eastern Pannonia' (Suebi page): the Quadic side of the Danube, admin1 Nitriansky…

successors.name: Ostrogoths
successors.text: 'somewhere near the old settlement area of the Marcomanni and the Quadi' (Hunimund page) and 'in or near north-eastern Pannonia' (Suebi page): the Quadic side of the Danube, admin1 Nitriansky…

ledger.x: 453: a Suebian kingdom forms on the Middle Danube after Attila's death.
468: Hunimund's Suebi are beaten by the Ostrogoths.
468: the Suebian kingdom on the Danube ends.

wars.name: Battle of Nedao
wars.outcome: The Gepid-led coalition, including 'the Suevi', defeats the Huns; Hunnic dominance in Central and Eastern Europe is broken and the Suebi are independent by the early 460s.

wars.name: Battle of Bolia
wars.outcome: Ostrogothic victory 'achieving supremacy in Pannonia'; Hunimund 'surrendered' and was adopted by Theodemir.

certainty.note: The pages place the kingdom only 'in or near north-eastern Pannonia' and near the Marcomannic and Quadic country; no boundary.
